correctness.rationale: For the literal printed 5x25 generator over F_3, independently parsed all 25 columns, computed 243 codewords and the complete coefficient table, and enumerated each r-plane in F_3^5 exactly once via its unique reduced-echelon basis. Totals for r=1..5 were 121,1210,1210,121,1 and exact support minima were (14,19,22,24,25); every support-profile coefficient agrees with the result. The 25 projective-normalized columns were distinct/nonzero. Exhaustive triple and quadruple relation checking gave 15 dependent triples and 486 four-supports, hence 30 and 972 low-weight dual words. Positions 1,7,9,10 were the only positions absent from dependent triples and all occur in dependent quadruples. Exact normalization gives the four locality-three exceptions and other 21 locality-two coordinates. The finite census is exhaustive by canonical RREF, not statistical sampling; rank 5 and Gram determinant 1 also follow from modular elimination.
